description: I hope everyone had a wonderful Independence Day celebrating our nation's 250th birthday. This milestone gave me an opportunity to reflect on what makes America so special. One of the greatest gifts our founders gave us was the opportunity to have a voice in our government. Whether it's voting, volunteering, attending a community meeting, or simply helping a neighbor, our country is strongest when people stay engaged. Nevada has always embodied that pioneering spirit. Our military families, first responders, healthcare professionals, educators, entrepreneurs, and small business owners make our communities stronger every day. It is an incredible honor to serve as your Assemblywoman and be your voice in Carson City.
title: Assembly District 35 August Newsletter!
